findings.name: manager_worker
findings.note: Users must SSH to a head node to access CRC services; documentation does not explicitly state whether head/login nodes can initiate direct connections to compute nodes.

citations.title: Connecting to CRC Servers — User Documentation  documentation
citations.heading: Connecting to CRC Servers — User Documentation  documentation > Connecting to CRC Servers 
citations.quote: All activity performed on the CRC infrastructure occurs on remote servers, this requires an ssh (Secure Shell) connection to a head node at the very least.
